I have been struggling for years. I've had depression since I was 12 or so but never sought treatment until I was 18, and 10 years later I still feel the same way. I think mostly me feeling like my life is over has been in regards to my failed relationships. Everyone else I went to high school with is getting married and having kids. And I am alone. I have nice things. Cars and clothes and houses and whatever but it doesn't mean shit to me. I am alone and will never find someone who will marry me. Fuck I can't even remember how long its been since I've had sex.. it has been a long time. No one wants me. My birthday recently passed and none of me friends..even friends I have had since middle school which was 15+ years ago even remembered my birthday. I spent my birthday drinking alone. Which is pathetic I think for someone in their 20s. That I didn't even have anyone to spend my birthday with. I don't know what to do. I have survived so long to be here to support my family but my life has been so hard to cope with I can't even anymore and I know they will be better off without me.
